# 74393 - Dual 4-bit binary ripple counter

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74393.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74393.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 42 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74393 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74393.png) | ![74393 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74393.png) | ![74393 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74393.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | clock |  |  | falling edge; count input of counter 1 |
| 2 | 1CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 3 | 1QA | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 4 | 1QB | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 5 | 1QC | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | 1QD | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 13 | 2A | clock |  |  | falling edge; count input of counter 2 |
| 12 | 2CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 11 | 2QA | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 10 | 2QB | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2QC | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 8 | 2QD | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,4,5,6 | 1QA..1QD = counter 1 bits | QA least significant. |
| 11,10,9,8 | 2QA..2QD = counter 2 bits | QA least significant. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: falling edge of 1A / 2A (each counter separately)

- nCLEAR high: nQA..nQD = L at once (positive logic note: high input to clear resets all four outputs low)
- nCLEAR low, falling edge of nA: count = count + 1 (mod 16); ripple: QA toggles on the A edge, QB on QA falling, QC on QB falling, QD on QC falling

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74393: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. A input IIL -3.2 mA, clear -1 mA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | QA | PLH | 12 | 20 |
| A | QA | PHL | 13 | 20 |
| A | QD | PLH | 40 | 60 |
| A | QD | PHL | 40 | 60 |
| CLEAR | any Q | PHL | 24 | 39 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| maxClockFrequency | A |  |  | 25 | 35 |
| pulseWidth | A |  | 20 |  |  |
| pulseWidth | CLEAR |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | CLEAR inactive | A falling | 25 |  |  |

## Not known

- '393 delays from A to QB and QC are not printed (only to QA and QD).
- No minimum propagation delays printed.

## Notes

Ripple-counter rule (QB clocked by QA etc.) is taken from the internal connection shown in the pin diagram and the 'ripple' description; the 7-489 page shows A feeding the first stage of each 4-bit counter.

- [TI The TTL Data Book 2nd ed. 1976, SN54390/SN54393/SN74390/SN74393 (bulletin DL-S 7612099, Oct 1976)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-489, 7-492, 7-493 (PDF pages 488, 491, 492); SN74393
